scope: Primary player implementation; semantic inspection only,no code copied into fvid.
observations: getNewNote updates selected instrNum when the instrument column is nonzero,but a no-note row only calls resetVolumes and triggerInstrument.
triggerNote is the operation that selects instrPtr and smpPtr from instrNum and updates sample default oldVol/oldPan.
resetVolumes restores oldVol/oldPan of the active sample; it does not select the newly named instrument sample.
A note-only trigger uses the selected instrument but does not reset channel volume/pan unless the row also names an instrument. Unset initial selection uses the silent placeholder.
